Mia T.: Heads up — while bringing Mistral-style-8B into the eval harness I see a reproducible BLEU drop (~4 pts) only on q4f quant runs. FP16 matches baseline.

Raj P.: Hmm. Do you have a minimal repro (prompt + tokenization) and which tokenizer version?

Mia T.: Repro below. Tokenizer v1 -> v2 changed merges; chat template padding behavior looks different and some ligatures are single token now. Example: 
```
CHAT_TEMPLATE = "<|system|>You are an assistant...
<|user|>{input}
<|assistant|>"
# tokenized lengths: v1=21 tokens, v2=18 tokens (shifted truncation)
```
Also seeing dataset-order sensitivity in CI (metrics jump between runs).

Devon L.: I dug in — eval/runner/ci_wrapper.py uses random.sample(dataset, k=len(dataset)) without seeding for shuffling. On CI we rely on deterministic caching/warmup behavior (KV cache warmups change when order flips) so quantized runs get different micro-batches and the metric moves.

Raj P.: Oof. That would explain order-dependent variance. Can you paste the offending snippet?

Devon L.: Snippet and suggested fix:
```python
# current
import random
shuffled = random.sample(dataset, k=len(dataset))
# proposal - deterministic using numpy rng from seed
import numpy as np
rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
shuffled = [dataset[i] for i in rng.permutation(len(dataset))]
```
This keeps permutations stable across runs when we set seed from CI_JOB_ID or explicit config.

Mia T.: Good catch. On tokenizer side, v2 merges some punctuation combos (e.g., "|-|" style markers) and our chat template relies on those tokens to preserve role separators. Plan: add tokenizer fallback that forces special tokens as single tokens when present. I'll add a small normalization patch in eval/harness/tokenizers/mistral_config.json.

Kayla S.: This is blocking the release checklist. Can we: 1) pin shuffle seed in CI, 2) add unit test for tokenization invariants, 3) land a small fallback for special tokens? Prioritize please. :eyes:

ci-bot: enqueue build fix/runner-determinism #3421 — started job at 1777843280

eval-bot: quick smoke (on latest commit): FP16 BLEU=31.2, Q4F BLEU=27.1, variance between runs ~3.8 pts when shuffle not pinned.

Raj P.: I'll add test at eval/harness/tests/test_repro.py to assert deterministic outputs given SEED env var. Test will run both tokenizer v1/v2 and check token counts for the chat template.

Devon L.: I'll open PR for runner seed patch + unit test. Patch also replaces random.sample usage across eval/runner.

Mia T.: I'll open tokenizer PR with a small whitelist of special tokens and add a quick integration test with a short prompt set.

Kayla S.: Please @me on the PRs. If CI still shows instability after these fixes we should consider a short patch to run each eval three times and median the metric as temporary mitigation.

Raj P.: Agreed. Adding flaky-run mitigation ticket.

Mia T.: Thanks all — will follow up with PR links. :thumbsup:
